evidence.name: AccessFix MVP Application CI
evidence.scope: Application test suite and configured CI checks for the exact checkout SHA.
limitations: CI success does not prove remote-site scanning, authenticated customer acceptance, or production readiness.

evidence.name: G1 Contract Verification
evidence.scope: Bootstrap, event-schema, contract, and independent OpenAPI verification.
limitations: Static contract checks do not establish production accessibility or external scanner security.

evidence.name: AccessFix PostgreSQL Runtime Proof
evidence.scope: Disposable PostgreSQL tenant/RLS, runtime, and logical restore proof.
limitations: Disposable logical restore does not prove production PITR, regional recovery, or RTO/RPO.

evidence.name: Disposable Chromium Patch Proof
evidence.scope: Browser and patch behavior on disposable local fixture inputs.
limitations: A fixture browser proof is not a remote website scan, egress/security audit, or human accessibility review.

evidence.name: AccessFix staging public readiness smoke
evidence.scope: Public health/readiness, anonymous protected-route denial, and public auth-client configuration checks.
limitations: The deployed service SHA is not proven by this smoke record.
This is not authenticated product or customer acceptance.
G1-D remains conditional/pending signoff and G1-E remains partial/open/blocked; green CI does not change those statuses.
AX-T01 through AX-T06 are not established as passed by these workflow runs; the recorded plan marks them not run.
The staging smoke workflow commit does not identify the deployed application commit or prove remote scanning safety.
